app.name: Patient Tracker
app.demoBanner: Prototype — demo data, stored only in this browser

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Clinic staff only
login.firstRun: First run — default logins (change them in Settings → Users):
login.f_search_text: Type an owner's name, a phone number or a pet's name and the record is there.
login.f_vaccines: Reminders that go out on time
login.f_vaccines_text: Vaccinations due this week are on the dashboard, one tap from a WhatsApp message.
login.f_receipts_text: Record the visit, add lines from the price list and print an A5 receipt.
login.serverUnreachable: Can't reach that address. Check it and the internet connection.
login.notSetUp: This clinic isn't set up on the server yet. The Admin signs in first.
login.firstSignInOnline: Can't reach the clinic server. The first sign-in on this device needs internet.
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.

dashboard.title: Today
dashboard.search: Search owner name, phone or pet name

owners.title: Owners
owners.whatsappHint: Leave empty if same as phone
owners.dupBody: {name} already has this phone number. Save a separate owner anyway?
owners.empty: No owners yet — add the first one

pets.name: Name
pets.microchipTaken: This microchip number is already registered
pets.transferHint: Changing the owner transfers the pet; its history stays with it

petRecord.weightEmpty: Weights recorded in visits appear here
petRecord.onServer: on the clinic server, downloads when opened
petRecord.fileNotHere: This file is on another device and isn’t on the clinic server yet, or there’s no connection. Try again later.

visits.vetOnly: Only doctors and admins can record visits
visits.minFields: Pet, date and type are enough to save

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.voidConfirm: Void this invoice? It stays on record but no longer counts toward the balance.
invoices.tempNumber: Temporary number: the final invoice number is given when this device syncs with the clinic server.

settings.title: Settings
settings.oneVet: At least one active admin is required
settings.passwordRequired: Password required for a new user
settings.exportHint: One sheet per table — owners, pets, visits, invoices… Money in EGP. Files go to the Exports folder in Documents, no questions asked.
settings.backupHint: The whole database in one .sqlite file. A copy is also taken automatically every day (last 14 kept) in:
settings.restoreConfirm: Replace ALL current data with this backup? This cannot be undone.
settings.importHint: Excel sheet with the columns in the template. Owners with the same phone are merged.
settings.importResult: Imported {owners} owners and {pets} pets. Skipped {skipped} rows.
settings.roleHint: Admin: everything incl. users and settings · Doctor: visits, no settings · Assistant: owners, pets, appointments, invoices
settings.resetConfirm: Make a new temporary password for {name}? Their current password stops working and they are signed out on every device.
settings.mustChange: Must choose a password at next sign-in
settings.devicesHint: Every laptop, phone and browser signed in to the clinic server. There is no limit on how many. Sign out a lost or replaced device here; it must sign in again to see any records.
settings.signOutConfirm: Sign out “{name}”? It will need a password to open the clinic’s records again.
settings.devicesOffline: Connect to the clinic server to see the devices.

updates.title: Updates
updates.autoHint: Checks for a new version when the app opens and every 4 hours, downloads it in the background and installs it when you restart or close the app. Clinic data is not touched; a backup copy is taken before every update.
updates.readyHint: It will be installed when you close the app — or restart now.
updates.portable: This portable copy cannot update itself — download the new version.
updates.reason_dev: Updates work only in the installed app (this is a development build).
updates.reason_web: Updates apply to the desktop app only.
updates.reason_platform: Automatic updates are not available on this system.
updates.reason_mac-move: The app is running from outside the Applications folder (from the downloaded disk image, or a temporary copy macOS made), so it can't update itself. Click Move to Applications — it moves itself and reopens. Clinic data is not affected.
updates.reason_mac-permission: This Mac user cannot replace the app in its folder, so it cannot update itself. Sign in as an administrator, or download the new version.

wa.vaccination: Hello {owner}, this is {clinic}. Reminder: {pet}'s {vaccine} vaccine is due on {date}. Reply to book a time.
wa.appointment: Hello {owner}, this is {clinic}. Reminder of {pet}'s appointment on {date} at {time}. Reply if you need to change it.
wa.balance: Hello {owner}, this is {clinic}. Invoice {number}: remaining balance {amount}. Thank you.
wa.portal: Hello {owner}, this is {clinic}. Your pets' page — appointments, vaccinations and prescriptions, always up to date: {link}

sync.off: Not connected to a clinic server
sync.title: Clinic server
sync.none: This device is not connected to a clinic server. Connect from the sign-in screen.
sync.revoked: This device was signed out by the admin. Sign in again.
sync.waitingFor: Changes made offline by {names} are kept on this laptop and will be sent when they sign in here again.

notify.title: Notifications

appointment.overlap: Double booking: {pet} ({at}) overlaps {other_pet} ({other_at}); they were booked on two devices without a connection

conflict.replaced: {by} changed {label} after you; your edit was replaced
conflict.kept: Your change to {label} was not applied: {by} changed it later

notify.pushOn: Turn on notifications on this device
notify.pushOnHint: So they arrive even when the app is closed.
notify.pushBlocked: Notifications are blocked for this site in the browser settings.
notify.pushActive: Notifications are on for this device.
notify.background: Keep running in the tray and start with the computer
notify.backgroundHint: Closing the window keeps notifications coming. Quit from the tray icon.

queue.emergency: 🚨 Emergency: {pet} ({owner}) is waiting for the vet: {complaint}

intake.title: Pre-diagnosis
intake.sub: Recorded before the vet sees the patient. The patient then waits in the vet’s queue.

password.title: Choose your password
password.sub: This is your first sign-in (or your password was reset). Choose a password only you know.
password.sameAsTemp: Choose a different password from the temporary one

invite.title: Send the sign-in details
invite.sub: Send {name} how to sign in. They must choose their own password the first time.
invite.subject: Your sign-in for {clinic}

backup.title: Clinic server backup
backup.hint: Every night after 2:00 the server saves a full copy of the clinic’s records, and the files, away from Railway. The Admin can also make a copy now or download one.
backup.offsiteNo: No bucket set up yet: only on the server’s volume (see RAILWAY-SETUP.md, Backups)
backup.storageBad: NOT on a volume: files and backups are lost at the next update. Add a Volume at /data in Railway.
backup.waiting: {n} file(s) waiting to be copied off-site
backup.offline: Connect to the clinic server to see its backups.

install.title: Install on this phone
install.android: Opens like any app, from the home screen, and works without a connection.
install.ios: On iPhone: tap Share (the square with an arrow), then “Add to Home Screen”.

rxArchive.title: Prescriptions
rxArchive.hint: Every prescription for this owner's pets, newest first. Search by drug, pet or diagnosis.

portal.title: Owner page
portal.intro: A private page for the owner with their details, pets, upcoming appointments and prescriptions. It updates by itself whenever the clinic saves something. Give them the QR card or send the link.
portal.needsServer: The owner page is on the clinic server. Connect this device to the clinic server first (Settings → Clinic server, Admin).
portal.replaceBody: The old QR code and link stop working at once and a new one is made. Use this when a card is lost.
portal.disableBody: The QR code and link stop working. You can create a new page later.
portal.archived: This owner is archived, so their page is switched off until they are active again.
portal.syncNote: Live on the owner's phone as soon as this device syncs.
portal.cardScan: Scan with your phone camera: your pets, upcoming appointments and prescriptions, always up to date.
portal.cardPrivate: Keep this card private. If you lose it, ask the clinic for a new code.

page.lead: Your pets' records at {clinic}, kept up to date by the clinic.
page.subscribeHint: Add all your appointments and vaccination dates to your calendar once: it then updates itself when the clinic books or moves one.
page.name: Name
page.detailsHint: Something wrong? Tell the clinic and they will correct it.
page.privacy: This page is private to you. If you lose your card, ask the clinic to replace the QR code: the old one stops working.
page.goneBody: Ask the clinic for your new QR code.
page.bookHint: Message the clinic on WhatsApp to book one.
page.allGood: All vaccinations are up to date
page.installHint: Tip: add this page to your phone's home screen (browser menu → Add to Home screen) to open it like an app.
